trial_court: Court of Ms. Anamika, M.M, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Amandeep Singh Kohli and others (husband, wife, etc.)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State (NCT of Delhi) and another (wife's family)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner husband and respondent wife got married in 2014, but due to matrimonial differences started living separately since 2017. The wife filed a petition under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, which was pending. The husband also filed a divorce petition, which was withdrawn.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement deed can dissolve a marriage by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has already been dissolved by way of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 vide judgment dated 06.08.2022 titled as Amandeep Singh Kohli and Gurpriya Kaur in HMA bearing No.962/2022 passed by the Court of Mr. Ajay Pandey, Judge, Family Courts, Karkardooma Courts, New Delhi.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement deed can be executed to settle disputes between parties.
legal_principles.held: The counsel for the petitioners and the respondent no. 2 stated that the petitioner no. 1 and the respondent no. 2 have already settled their disputes vide Settlement/Compromise Deed dated 15.03.2022, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed.

outcome.final_order: The FIR bearing no. 278/2017 registered under sections 406/498A/34 IPC is quashed.
